core_obligations: Compactify X over Y to reduce to finite presentation.
Approximate and descend the whole situation to finite type over Z.
Apply the Noetherian Chow/Nagata lemma and pull the diagram back.

proof_roadmap.step: Noetherian approximation plus descent to the Noetherian case.

difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space Y over a scheme S and a separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y, the lemma builds a diagram X <- X' -> closure(X)' -> Y with X' -> X proper surjective, X' an open subspace of closure(X)', and closure(X)' -> Y proper and representable. The retained proof is written in two reduction stages: first a closed immersion of X into a space X_1 separated of finite presentation over Y (Limits of Spaces, proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation) reduces to finite presentation; then absolute Noetherian approximation writes Y as a directed limit of finite type Z-spaces, descends X_i -> Y_i of finite presentation with the separated property (Limits of Spaces, lemmas descend-finite-presentation and descend-separated-morphism), and applies the Noetherian case of the chapter (lemma-chow-noetherian). Retained author proof at lines 9400-9429.
